subject: Bar/Crossbar width when using summary option and disabling legend

messages.author: ff6365b278ee2331
messages.subject: Bar/Crossbar width when using summary option and disabling legend
parts:
Hi,

When creating bar/crossbar plots choosing summary, where can you set the width of the bar/crossbar, since these parameters are not available under options when using summary?
Another question would be: How can I disable one of two legends? For example, first legend is a color code for two different variables and the second legend is for color code of error bar lines for each of these variables (this one I don't need).

Thank you for your help.

Rok

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Bar/Crossbar width when using summary option and disabling legend
parts:
I'm not sure that it is possible to change the crossbar width in ggplot2, so it is not possible in the Builder.

To disable a legend drag in a scale (for example scale_color_hue) and set the guide to "none"


ian
